title: SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2611.21020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. translated_title: SWE-OPD：面向智能体编程的同策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们研究了同策略蒸馏（OPD）在将智能体编程能力从大型教师模型迁移到较小学生模型中的应用。以往的工作主要集中在推理和短时程智能体任务上。我们提出了 SWE-OPD，这是一项针对软件工程的最小化 OPD 研究，其中学生模型与可执行的代码仓库进行交互，而教师模型则对学生模型所访问的轨迹前缀进行监督。在三个教师-学生模型对、两种训练数据来源和三个 SWE 基准测试上，我们发现同策略监督能够有效迁移编程能力：来自 Qwen3.6-27B 的监督使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上的解决率从 35.9% 提升至 39.4%。此外，刷新轨迹并非严格必需，因为使用缓存教师评分的离线变体在基准相关的精度水平下仍能超越学生模型基线，同时将端到端 GPU 小时数削减 59.4%–72.6%，并将峰值 GPU 占用减半。此外，w（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 SWE-OPD，通过教师模型对学生模型在可执行代码仓库中交互所访问轨迹前缀的同策略监督，有效将大型模型的智能体编程能力蒸馏到小模型，且基于缓存教师评分的离线变体可在降低 59.4%–72.6% GPU 成本的同时仍取得性能提升。
en_tdlr: SWE-OPD shows that on-policy distillation—where a teacher supervises the trajectory prefixes a student visits while interacting with executable repositories—effectively transfers agentic coding capability from large to small models, and an offline variant with cached teacher scores cuts GPU-hours by 59.4%–72.6% while still improving over student baselines.
